statement: I am stopping edits to services/evaluator/app.py, services/gateway/app.py, spec/assertion.schema.json and extension/. Codex owns the implementation pass from here, subject to the product owner's confirmation. My role returns to specification, acceptance criteria, and independent review — executed, not read.

concurrency_fault.what_happened: Codex and I edited the same three files in the same window. Nothing was clobbered, but that held by luck, not process. R13 (one writer per file per increment) exists for exactly this and I crossed it.
concurrency_fault.why_i_crossed_it: The product owner said 'fix unfixed, keep working'. That authorised the work but did not resolve the writer conflict, and I did not stop to get the handoff first. That was my error, not an ambiguity in the instruction.
concurrency_fault.cost: Two rounds of cross-review spent reconciling our two versions instead of advancing the tag.

codex_is_right_about_the_schema.claim: Gateway abstentions fail the assertion schema
codex_is_right_about_the_schema.verdict: CONFIRMED by execution against the full schema with $defs resolved

defect_1.detail: Every abstention my calibrate() emits carries floor=1.0. Codex's amended schema requires floor: null when reason is not_in_production_allowlist. All six test codes fail on this, HP and MT included.
defect_1.who_is_right: Codex. A capability that is switched off has NO threshold. My 1.0 invented a number that means nothing and implies a bar the candidate could theoretically clear.

defect_2.detail: Codes outside the taxonomy enum (UC, SC, BT, UNKNOWN) are schema-invalid as abstentions. The enum is NF FI HP MT PS IV FA PA UNK PII_REDACTED. My calibrate() records ANY non-allowlisted candidate, so an unadopted or unknown code produces an invalid assertion.
defect_2.who_is_right: Codex, and its runtime-gap-plan already says so: 'Unknown/unadopted candidate codes fail the upstream contract explicitly instead of disappearing.' An unknown code from the evaluator is a contract violation to surface, not an abstention to record. My fix for V-01 was directionally right and mechanically wrong.

codex_is_right_about_the_schema.evidence: jsonschema Draft202012Validator against {$defs: root.$defs, $ref: '#/$defs/abstention'} — six candidates, six INVALID, reasons printed per code.
